latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of term-sheet-negotiation-coach.
- Coaches founders through every major term in a venture financing term sheet, including key economic and control terms.
- Covers topics like valuation, option pool top-up, liquidation preference (including variations), anti-dilution provisions, board setup, and more.
- Outlines a diagnostic process to assess founder leverage and stage/context before reviewing the term sheet.
- Includes negotiation tips, leverage mapping, and guidance on what’s standard versus what to push back on.
- Intended as a practical, founder-first playbook to prepare for legal counsel and negotiation—not as legal advice.
